';scene.classList.remove('bonk')},680)}
function net(item,assisted=false){const r=round;if(!r||phase!=='wave'||item.done||g.paused||now()<r.goUntil)return;item.done=true;const cell=r.cells[item.slot];clearObj(item);impact(cell);if(item.kind==='hat'){g.hats++;r.hatsCaught++;points(45);bonk();flash('😂 BONK BABA! +45 CHAOS',640);toast('BABA IS NOT A RACCOON!')}else{g.caught++;r.realCaught++;points(item.key?330:175);earn(item.key?17:12);if(item.key){g.key=true;$('keyCue').classList.remove('show');toast('🔑 KEY RACCOON NETTED!',1150)}else{if(!assisted)flash('🦝 GOTCHA!',360)}}hud()}
function endWave(){const r=round;if(!r||r.finished)return;r.finished=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;phase='interlude';$('scene').className='';$('countdown').classList.remove('show');$('netBoard').classList.remove('show');$('keyCue').classList.remove('show');$('powers').classList.remove('show');$('report').classList.add('show');g.waveResults.push({caught:r.realCaught,missed:r.realMissed,hats:r.hatsCaught});const lines=['Cat: I accept no responsibility for my relatives.','Mo: I counted those. It was not reassuring.','Savvy: *Sighs across the entire server.*'];$('speechName').textContent=['CATALYST','MO','SAVVY'][r.index];$('speechText').textContent=lines[r.index].replace(/^\w+: /,'');$('speech').className='from-sea hidden';showCompanion(r.index===1?'Mo':'Catalyst');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');$('reportTitle').textContent='WAVE '+(r.index+1)+' COMPLETE';$('reportText').innerHTML='<strong>'+r.realCaught+'</strong> caught · <strong>'+r.realMissed+'</strong> escaped'+(r.hatsCaught?' · '+r.hatsCaught+' Baba bonk':'');setPanel('Wave '+(r.index+1)+' Finished','Caught '+r.realCaught+' raccoons, '+r.realMissed+' escaped. '+(r.hatsCaught?'Also bonked Baba. He deserved it.':''),'THE CHAOS CONTINUES');if(r.index===2)buttons([['FACE MO’S VERDICT ▶',verdict]]);else buttons([['NEXT RACCOON WAVE ▶',()=>startWave(r.index+1)]])}
function verdict(){phase='verdict';$('report').classList.remove('show');$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');showCompanion('Mo');$('guestChip').classList.remove('show');const good=g.caught>=7;if(good){say('Mo','...Fine. At least you caught most of them.');setPanel('Mo Is Reluctantly Impressed','Tiny somehow rescued enough raccoons to avoid a timeout. Mostly.','MO’S VERDICT');points(240);buttons([['FOLLOW THE TRAIN KEYS ▶',finish]])}else{say('Mo','Tiny. CORNER. NOW.');setPanel('The Timeout Corner','Too many raccoons escaped! Choose how to respond. No game over, just consequences.','MO’S VERDICT');buttons([['SINCERE APOLOGY',()=>{points(80);finish()}],['CAT, DISTRACT HER!',()=>{points(140);finish()},true]])}}
function finish(){phase='complete';g.completed=true;save();$('speech').classList.remove('hidden');$('speechName').textContent='TINY';$('speechText').textContent='Emergency bear onesie. Emergency train. Absolutely no consequences.';guest('Savvy');setPanel('STAGE 3 COMPLETE','The last raccoon bolts toward the train station with something shiny. Next: Tiny and Devi’s train!','NEXT STOP • THE CHAOS EXPRESS');$('report').classList.add('show');$('reportTitle').textContent='THE GREAT RACCOON INCIDENT';$('reportText').innerHTML='<strong>'+g.caught+'/12</strong> raccoons caught · <strong>'+g.escaped+'</strong> escaped · <strong>'+g.score.toLocaleString()+'</strong> chaos'+(g.key?' · 🔑 train key found':' · 🔑 key missing');buttons([['CONTINUE TO STAGE 4 ▸',()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_STAGE_DONE',stage:3,score:g.score,energy:g.energy,meta:{caught:g.caught,escaped:g.escaped,key:g.key,plan:g.plan,misses:g.misses}},'*')],['REPLAY STAGE 3 ↻',start,true]])}
function usePower(name){if(g.paused)return;const cost={puppy:30,raccoons:60,rage:100}[name];if(phase!=='wave'||g.energy<cost)return;g.energy-=cost;const r=round;if(name==='puppy'){r.endAt+=5000;toast('🥺 +5 SECONDS TO CATCH THEM!')}else if(name==='raccoons'){const a=r.objects.find(o=>!o.done&&o.kind==='real');if(a)net(a,true);else g.autoNet++}else{const candidates=r.objects.filter(o=>!o.done&&o.kind==='real');if(candidates.length){candidates.forEach(o=>net(o,true));toast('🍗 EMERGENCY NET STORM!')}else{g.autoNet+=2;toast('🍗 NEXT TWO RACCOONS AUTO-NETTED!')}}hud()}
function togglePause(){if(phase==='intro'||phase==='plan'||phase==='ready'||phase==='interlude'||phase==='complete'||phase==='verdict'){g.paused=!g.paused;toast(g.paused?'⏸ PAUSED':'▶ RESUMED');$('pause').textContent=g.paused?'▶':'Ⅱ';return}g.paused=!g.paused;$('pause').textContent=g.paused?'▶':'Ⅱ';toast(g.paused?'⏸ PAUSED':'▶ RESUMED');hud()}
function openGuide(){guideWasOpen=g.paused;g.paused=true;$('guide').classList.add('show');hud()}
function closeGuide(){$('guide').classList.remove('show');g.paused=guideWasOpen;hud()}
$('help').addEventListener('click',openGuide);$('guideGo').addEventListener('click',closeGuide);$('closeGuide').addEventListener('click',closeGuide);$('pause').addEventListener('click',togglePause);$('music').addEventListener('click',()=>{$('music').textContent=$('music').textContent==='♫'?'♪̸':'♫';toast('Sound setting changed')});$('full').addEventListener('click',()=>window.parent.postMessage({type:'TINY_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN'},'*'));
for(const name of ['puppy','raccoons','rage'])$(name).addEventListener('click',()=>usePower(name));
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&$('guide').classList.contains('show'))closeGuide();if(e.key===' '&&phase==='wave'&&!g.paused){e.preventDefault();const o=round.objects.find(o=>!o.done&&o.kind==='real');if(o)net(o)}});
/* Local-only trial hooks for browser regression tests; not connected to live scoreboards. */
window.__stage3Test={get state(){return {phase,game:{...g},wave:round?{index:round.index,queue:round.queue.length,active:round.cells.map(c=>c.current?.kind||null),caught:round.realCaught,missed:round.realMissed,keyActive:round.objects.some(o=>o.key&&!o.done),complete:round.finished}:null}},startWave:(n)=>startWave(n),netFirst:()=>{const o=round?.objects.find(x=>!x.done&&x.kind==='real');if(o)net(o)},tapHole:(n)=>round?.cells[n]?.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true})),goToChoice:planChoice,finish:finish};
start();
})();
</script></body></html>
